overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Board's unposted December 8, 2010 re-vote was not reasonably anticipated by the chair, and conflict-of-interest claims were outside the Open Meeting Law and declined.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board discussed and voted on a re-vote of human services contracts at its Dec. 8, 2010 meeting, a matter not posted 48 hours in advance.
allegations.key_passage: It therefore appears this item was not reasonably anticipated.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged Board members acted on human services contracts despite conflicts of interest.
allegations.key_passage: We make no finding as to the allegations that Board members acted with conflicts of interest, as this subject area is not addressed by the Open Meeting Law
